versions.changelog:
Initial release of the antfu-slidev skill.

- Create and present developer-focused, web-based slidedecks using Slidev with Markdown and Vue integration.
- Supports interactive code blocks, syntax highlighting, live editing (Monaco), and code walkthroughs.
- Built-in features for animations, diagrams (Mermaid/PlantUML), LaTeX math, and presenter notes.
- Includes quick start instructions, core feature references, and exporting to PDF/PPTX/SPA.
- Rich documentation covering usage scenarios, CLI commands, layout, styling, and extension points.
